en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before the LORD, and died;

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦的两个儿子近到耶和华面前死了。死了之后，耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫的兩個兒子近到耶和華面前死了。死了之後，耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: and the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

zhSimplified.text: 「要告诉你哥哥亚伦，不可随时进圣所的幔子内、到柜上的施恩座前，免得他死亡，因为我要从云中显现在施恩座上。

zhTraditional.text: 「要告訴你哥哥亞倫，不可隨時進聖所的幔子內、到櫃上的施恩座前，免得他死亡，因為我要從雲中顯現在施恩座上。

en.text: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦进圣所，要带一只公牛犊为赎罪祭，一只公绵羊为燔祭。

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫進聖所，要帶一隻公牛犢為贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊為燔祭。

en.text: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

zhSimplified.text: 要穿上细麻布圣内袍，把细麻布裤子穿在身上，腰束细麻布带子，头戴细麻布冠冕；这都是圣服。他要用水洗身，然后穿戴。

zhTraditional.text: 要穿上細麻布聖內袍，把細麻布褲子穿在身上，腰束細麻布帶子，頭戴細麻布冠冕；這都是聖服。他要用水洗身，然後穿戴。

en.text: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

zhSimplified.text: 要从以色列会众取两只公山羊为赎罪祭，一只公绵羊为燔祭。

zhTraditional.text: 要從以色列會眾取兩隻公山羊為贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊為燔祭。

en.text: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

zhSimplified.text: 「亚伦要把赎罪祭的公牛奉上，为自己和本家赎罪；

zhTraditional.text: 「亞倫要把贖罪祭的公牛奉上，為自己和本家贖罪；

en.text: He shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

zhSimplified.text: 也要把两只公山羊安置在会幕门口、耶和华面前，

zhTraditional.text: 也要把兩隻公山羊安置在會幕門口、耶和華面前，

en.text: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

zhSimplified.text: 为那两只羊拈阄，一阄归与耶和华，一阄归与阿撒泻勒。

zhTraditional.text: 為那兩隻羊拈鬮，一鬮歸與耶和華，一鬮歸與阿撒瀉勒。

en.text: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin offering.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦要把那拈阄归与耶和华的羊献为赎罪祭，

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫要把那拈鬮歸與耶和華的羊獻為贖罪祭，

en.text: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

zhSimplified.text: 但那拈阄归与阿撒泻勒的羊要活着安置在耶和华面前，用以赎罪，打发人送到旷野去，归与阿撒泻勒。

zhTraditional.text: 但那拈鬮歸與阿撒瀉勒的羊要活着安置在耶和華面前，用以贖罪，打發人送到曠野去，歸與阿撒瀉勒。

en.text: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

zhSimplified.text: 「亚伦要把赎罪祭的公牛牵来宰了，为自己和本家赎罪；

zhTraditional.text: 「亞倫要把贖罪祭的公牛牽來宰了，為自己和本家贖罪；

en.text: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

zhSimplified.text: 拿香炉，从耶和华面前的坛上盛满火炭，又拿一捧捣细的香料，都带入幔子内，

zhTraditional.text: 拿香爐，從耶和華面前的壇上盛滿火炭，又拿一捧搗細的香料，都帶入幔子內，

en.text: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

zhSimplified.text: 在耶和华面前，把香放在火上，使香的烟云遮掩法柜上的施恩座，免得他死亡；

zhTraditional.text: 在耶和華面前，把香放在火上，使香的煙雲遮掩法櫃上的施恩座，免得他死亡；

en.text: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

zhSimplified.text: 也要取些公牛的血，用指头弹在施恩座的东面，又在施恩座的前面弹血七次。

zhTraditional.text: 也要取些公牛的血，用指頭彈在施恩座的東面，又在施恩座的前面彈血七次。

en.text: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

zhSimplified.text: 「随后他要宰那为百姓作赎罪祭的公山羊，把羊的血带入幔子内，弹在施恩座的上面和前面，好像弹公牛的血一样。

zhTraditional.text: 「隨後他要宰那為百姓作贖罪祭的公山羊，把羊的血帶入幔子內，彈在施恩座的上面和前面，好像彈公牛的血一樣。

en.text: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

zhSimplified.text: 他因以色列人诸般的污秽、过犯，就是他们一切的罪愆，当这样在圣所行赎罪之礼，并因会幕在他们污秽之中，也要照样而行。

zhTraditional.text: 他因以色列人諸般的污穢、過犯，就是他們一切的罪愆，當這樣在聖所行贖罪之禮，並因會幕在他們污穢之中，也要照樣而行。

en.text: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 他进圣所赎罪的时候，会幕里不可有人，直等到他为自己和本家并以色列全会众赎了罪出来。

zhTraditional.text: 他進聖所贖罪的時候，會幕裏不可有人，直等到他為自己和本家並以色列全會眾贖了罪出來。

en.text: “He shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 他出来，要到耶和华面前的坛那里，在坛上行赎罪之礼，又要取些公牛的血和公山羊的血，抹在坛上四角的周围；

zhTraditional.text: 他出來，要到耶和華面前的壇那裏，在壇上行贖罪之禮，又要取些公牛的血和公山羊的血，抹在壇上四角的周圍；

en.text: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 也要用指头把血弹在坛上七次，洁净了坛，从坛上除掉以色列人诸般的污秽，使坛成圣。」

zhTraditional.text: 也要用指頭把血彈在壇上七次，潔淨了壇，從壇上除掉以色列人諸般的污穢，使壇成聖。」

en.text: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

zhSimplified.text: 「亚伦为圣所和会幕并坛献完了赎罪祭，就要把那只活着的公山羊奉上。

zhTraditional.text: 「亞倫為聖所和會幕並壇獻完了贖罪祭，就要把那隻活着的公山羊奉上。

en.text: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.

zhSimplified.text: 两手按在羊头上，承认以色列人诸般的罪孽过犯，就是他们一切的罪愆，把这罪都归在羊的头上，借着所派之人的手，送到旷野去。

zhTraditional.text: 兩手按在羊頭上，承認以色列人諸般的罪孽過犯，就是他們一切的罪愆，把這罪都歸在羊的頭上，藉着所派之人的手，送到曠野去。

en.text: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

zhSimplified.text: 要把这羊放在旷野，这羊要担当他们一切的罪孽，带到无人之地。

zhTraditional.text: 要把這羊放在曠野，這羊要擔當他們一切的罪孽，帶到無人之地。

en.text: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

zhSimplified.text: 「亚伦要进会幕，把他进圣所时所穿的细麻布衣服脱下，放在那里，

zhTraditional.text: 「亞倫要進會幕，把他進聖所時所穿的細麻布衣服脫下，放在那裏，

en.text: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

zhSimplified.text: 又要在圣处用水洗身，穿上衣服，出来，把自己的燔祭和百姓的燔祭献上，为自己和百姓赎罪。

zhTraditional.text: 又要在聖處用水洗身，穿上衣服，出來，把自己的燔祭和百姓的燔祭獻上，為自己和百姓贖罪。

en.text: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 赎罪祭牲的脂油要在坛上焚烧。

zhTraditional.text: 贖罪祭牲的脂油要在壇上焚燒。

en.text: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

zhSimplified.text: 那放羊归与阿撒泻勒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。

zhTraditional.text: 那放羊歸與阿撒瀉勒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。

en.text: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

zhSimplified.text: 作赎罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既带入圣所赎罪，这牛羊就要搬到营外，将皮、肉、粪用火焚烧。

zhTraditional.text: 作贖罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既帶入聖所贖罪，這牛羊就要搬到營外，將皮、肉、糞用火焚燒。

en.text: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

zhSimplified.text: 焚烧的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。」

zhTraditional.text: 焚燒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。」

en.text: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

zhSimplified.text: 「每逢七月初十日，你们要刻苦己心，无论是本地人，是寄居在你们中间的外人，什么工都不可做；这要作你们永远的定例。

zhTraditional.text: 「每逢七月初十日，你們要刻苦己心，無論是本地人，是寄居在你們中間的外人，甚麼工都不可做；這要作你們永遠的定例。

en.text: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 因在这日要为你们赎罪，使你们洁净。你们要在耶和华面前得以洁净，脱尽一切的罪愆。

zhTraditional.text: 因在這日要為你們贖罪，使你們潔淨。你們要在耶和華面前得以潔淨，脫盡一切的罪愆。

en.text: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

zhSimplified.text: 这日你们要守为圣安息日，要刻苦己心；这为永远的定例。

zhTraditional.text: 這日你們要守為聖安息日，要刻苦己心；這為永遠的定例。

en.text: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

zhSimplified.text: 那受膏、接续他父亲承接圣职的祭司要穿上细麻布的圣衣，行赎罪之礼。

zhTraditional.text: 那受膏、接續他父親承接聖職的祭司要穿上細麻布的聖衣，行贖罪之禮。

en.text: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

zhSimplified.text: 他要在至圣所和会幕与坛行赎罪之礼，并要为众祭司和会众的百姓赎罪。

zhTraditional.text: 他要在至聖所和會幕與壇行贖罪之禮，並要為眾祭司和會眾的百姓贖罪。

en.text: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 这要作你们永远的定例—就是因以色列人一切的罪，要一年一次为他们赎罪。」 亚伦照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。

zhTraditional.text: 這要作你們永遠的定例－就是因以色列人一切的罪，要一年一次為他們贖罪。」 亞倫照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
